brief:
An Israeli strike on a truck in Gaza on Saturday killed three people, the Gaza Health Ministry reported, Al-Monitor said. Witnesses described the vehicle as carrying food and documents bearing the World Central Kitchen logo, though the humanitarian organization stated it had no affiliation with the truck.

The discrepancy between witness accounts and the charity's statement raises questions about the vehicle's actual purpose and cargo at the time of the strike.
dek: JERUSALEM, Nov 21 (Reuters) - Israeli forces hit a truck in Gaza on Saturday which witnesses said was carrying food and papers bearing the logo of the World Central Kitchen charity, but the organisation said the vehicle was not affiliated with it.
title: Israeli strike kills three in Gaza vehicle, charity denies link
